verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Appwrite publishes its own MCP server (server role) for external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex to operate on Appwrite projects. Serving tools to other agents is a different capability and cannot be credited to this story. Nothing documents Appwrite itself connecting to or consuming third-party MCP servers, for example through its AI product, Console or Functions, so there is no evidence it delivers this story.
